```{r ergm-data, echo = FALSE}
library(data.table)
ergm_data <- list.files(
    "simoutbreak-data",
    pattern = "ergm-sim.+total_hist",
    full.names = TRUE
    )

ergm_data <- lapply(ergm_data, fread)
ergm_data <- rbindlist(ergm_data)

ergm_deseased <- ergm_data[status == "Deseased"]

ergm_data <- ergm_data[, .(
    `2.5%` = quantile(counts, probs = .025),
    `Mean` = mean(counts),
    `97.5%` = quantile(counts, probs = .975)
), by = .(date, status)]
```

```{r degseq-data, echo = FALSE}
degseq_data <- list.files(
    "simoutbreak-data",
    pattern = "degseq-sim.+total_hist",
    full.names = TRUE
    )

degseq_data <- lapply(degseq_data, fread)
degseq_data <- rbindlist(degseq_data)

degseq_deseased <- degseq_data[status == "Deseased"]

degseq_data <- degseq_data[, .(
    `2.5%` = quantile(counts, probs = .025),
    `Mean` = mean(counts),
    `97.5%` = quantile(counts, probs = .975)
), by = .(date, status)]
```

```{r, fig.height=5, fig.width=6, dev="pdf", out.width="1\\linewidth"}
library(ggplot2)

all_data <- rbind(
    cbind(ergm_data, model = "ERGM"),
    cbind(degseq_data, model = "Degree sequence")
)

ggplot(all_data[status == "Deseased"], aes(x = date)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Mean, colour = model, lty = model), lwd = 1.5) +
  labs(
    colour  = "Graph Generating Process",
    x       = "Days since first infection",
    caption = "Based on 1,000 replicates.",
    y       = "Number of Deaths"
    ) +
  guides(lty = "none") + 
  theme(
    legend.position = c(.2, .85),
    legend.background = element_blank()
    ) 

ggplot(all_data[status == "Deseased"], aes(x = date)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = `2.5%`, ymax = `97.5%`, fill = model), alpha = .5) +
    geom_line(aes(y = Mean, colour = model))
```

Testing significance

```{r}
t.test(all_data[status == "Deseased"])

values <- list()
for (i in 1:100) {
    values[[i]] <- t.test(
        degseq_deseased[date == i, counts],
        ergm_deseased[date == i, counts], 
        alternative = "two.sided",
        paired = FALSE
    )
}

pvals <- data.table(
    Date = 1:100,
    `P-value` = sapply(values, "[[", "p.value")
)[-c(1,2)]

ggplot(pvals, aes(x = Date, y = `P-value`)) +
    geom_point() + scale_y_log10(limits = c(min(pvals$`P-value`), NA))
```
